generate_anchors: generate a matrix of anchor boxes in x1 y1 x2 y2 format with configurable stride sizes and aspect ratios
generate_anchors_custom_sizes: generate anchor boxes with custom sizes and aspect ratios for an RPN in object detection
whctrs: compute the width height x center and y center from an anchor box window
mkanchors: construct anchor boxes from a vector of widths heights and a center point
ratio_enum: enumerate a set of anchor boxes for each aspect ratio relative to a given anchor
